title: Kingyo Sukui
tagline: Lift the fish before the paper tears.
description: The summer festival pastime of goldfish scooping. Dip a paper scoop, slide it under a goldfish and lift before the wet paper tears. Stall sessions, a daily tank, free scooping and Watch & Learn, with every fish put back at the end.
howToPlay: Press on the water to dip the paper scoop.
Drag slowly: fast moves scare the fish.
Let go when a fish is inside the ring to lift it.
Watch the paper: time in the water and heavy fish wear it out.
Three sheets make a session; use Think for a suggestion.
